summary: Blumenthal’s request and Trump’s public response put responsibility for troop protection in view. Bahrain reported intercepting Iranian drones, the Supreme Court took up the asylum case and the chip rule has an expected publication date. This focused review leaves the November 17 Bahrain episode, Alaska’s final tabulation, the Venezuela talks and prisoner handovers open. The White House reportedly asserted control over whether staff agree to testify before Congress. Application to a named witness remains open.
scope: Focused review of troop protection and the response to CBS, Iran diplomacy and military operations, congressional proceedings, election and party leadership, asylum litigation and chip rules. Venezuela’s closing agreement, the Russia–Ukraine prisoner handover and several court and government decisions remain unverified.
